Switching to 4-4-2 and benching Treu collects a large points gain for nothing — no cash, no sale, no risk. Do that first. Second, the conditional sale that was waiting on this purchase has now FIRED and is unconditional: Matsima goes, and he goes today rather than late, because he is falling and every daily tick held is a pure loss. Treu still goes late, because he is rising. Properly unwound, the whole Engelhardt deal is net accretive per matchday against the state we would have been in without it, so the reversal that authorised the offer is vindicated on outcome and not merely on argument.
